shortDescription.text: TLS without a post-quantum key exchange: rustls with the ring crypto provider

fullDescription.text: rustls with the ring crypto provider at crates/cli/src/utils/mod.rs:260: the configured key exchange (ring) has no hybrid ML-KEM group such as X25519MLKEM768 (RFC 10024), so the handshake cannot negotiate one. Build rustls with the aws-lc-rs provider (rustls::crypto::aws_lc_rs) and the prefer-post-quantum feature, which puts X25519MLKEM768 first. This is a forward-looking risk that depends on the arrival of a cryptographically relevant quantum computer (CRQC). No such computer is publicly known to exist today; the timeline is uncertain. It is not a present-day exploitable vulnerability. Read from code and manifests only: the library versions deployed and settings made outside the code (environment, launch flags) were not determined.
